preconditions: Pin the current source and local role image. Use separate provisioned role configurations for protected qualification.

normal_steps.action: Start packaged Core on a protected socket and render the full route graph.
normal_steps.expected: Correct proxy peer and absent-session behavior. Exact Envoy accepts all role configs.
normal_steps.actual: Linux socket custody verified and all eleven Envoy configs accepted.

adverse_steps.action: Exercise protected replay startup with a wrong proxy UID or missing browser session.
adverse_steps.expected: Reject kernel peer or browser authority failure.
adverse_steps.actual: Wrong UID returned 403. Replay without a session returned 401.

adverse_steps.action: Deploy and qualify all protected role and load boundaries.
adverse_steps.expected: Observed protected mTLS, private Help, and declared-workload timing.

checks.name: source-regression
checks.expected: Locked source, security and regression checks pass on owned TLS database.
checks.actual: 38 of 39 commands passed. 1792 backend passed, 4 skipped, and 234 frontend passed. The only failing case exceeded the IMP-08 policy p95 limit by 3.407 ms.

checks.name: latency-isolated-rerun
checks.expected: Repeat the sole failing case with the unchanged 50 ms threshold.
checks.actual: Isolated p95 was 40.169 ms. Earlier full run measured 43.753 ms.

checks.name: protected-packaged-launcher
checks.expected: Actual restricted Linux role starts from the image and checks Unix UID.
checks.actual: The proxy UID got the Training shell and a 401 for missing replay authentication. A non-proxy UID got 403.

checks.name: pinned-envoy-validation
checks.expected: All generated role listeners are accepted by exact Envoy.
checks.actual: All eleven role files passed network-disabled parser validation.

checks.name: first-live-loopback
checks.expected: Live combined loopback workload completes within the configured deadlines.
checks.actual: Both reserved warm requests timed out. Fixture teardown limited durable-outcome observation.

checks.name: serial-live-loopback
checks.expected: Ten active sessions and combined role faults on loopback with exact loaded model.
checks.actual: Serial retry passed with live Qwen, ten active sessions, two occupied slots and eight queued tasks.

checks.name: protected-kubernetes-profile
checks.expected: Independently deployed current protected workload topology with exact role trust and private Help.
checks.actual: Role application and mesh source now exist. A provisioned isolated topology with the signed identities, stores, OIDC settings, replay policy and model bindings is pending.

checks.name: deployed-declared-load-distributions
checks.expected: Repeated cold, warm and failure timing at ten sessions against the protected topology.
checks.actual: Earlier controlled observations and the local loopback result retain their measured scopes.

residuals: Provision the isolated protected profile using the current application and mesh bindings, distinct workload identities, TLS stores, OIDC, replay policy and exact model qualification.
Run deployed protected workload and live dependency probes, and prove private Help behavior during the protected outage.
Measure repeated cold, warm and error timing at the declared ten-session load in that topology.
acceptance_scope: Protected role application composition, exact mesh configuration and local role checks; deployed G-10 qualification remains open.
rollback: Retain the exact restored local model and current authority settings. No service deployment or release was performed.
